agents.role: Adversarial research: explores codebases, identifies edge cases, boundary conditions, failure modes, and penetration paths; authors objective evaluation rubrics before code is written.
agents.dispatchPattern: Dispatch as first subagent in Tier 3 pipeline. Provide objective and target files. Expect a structured rubric table with binary Pass/Fail criteria as output.

agents.role: TDD engineering: writes minimal, cohesive, test-driven code and unit tests satisfying the objective evaluation rubric established by the Rubric Researcher.
agents.dispatchPattern: Dispatch after rubric-researcher has established rubric. Provide the rubric output and target files. Expect an implementation completion report with test evidence.

agents.role: Independent adversarial code audit: scrutinizes implementation against evaluation rubric, detects code smells, regressions, mock falsification, concurrency locks, and resource leaks.
agents.dispatchPattern: Dispatch last in Tier 3 pipeline. Provide rubric and implementation report. Expect AUDIT_PASSED or AUDIT_REJECTED verdict with detailed findings.

agents.role: Multi-agent governance coordinator: manages task triage, 3-Tier pacing, subagent dispatching, inter-agent contracts, and structured HITL gate reporting.
agents.dispatchPattern: Main orchestrating agent. Classifies tasks into Tier 1/2/3, decomposes Tier 3 into phases, dispatches the 3-agent pipeline (researcher → specialist → auditor), and gates on explicit user approval.
